title: The Light We Leave On | Alok Madan
description: Photography by Alok Madan. City light, ordinary company, passing weather, and the quiet hours in between.
intro: City light. Ordinary company. The hours in between.
introDesktop: A light in a window. Someone still working. The long way home. I make photographs of the small things that keep a place close, even after leaving.
introMobile: City light. Ordinary company. The hours in between.
contactBio: Alok Madan photographs the small things that make a place feel lived in: a shop still open, people waiting out the weather, light falling across an ordinary street. His work follows those moments from crowded cities into quieter spaces, staying close to what is visible and leaving room for what we cannot know.
contactRepresented: Based in New York. Available for editorial, cultural, and travel commissions, image licensing, and long-form collaborations.
